category: 组合数学 / 计数组合
literal_source_claim_en: a lower bound for the size of subset sums
source_attribution: Paul Erdos / Hans Heilbronn, 1964 (catalog metadata; no citation)
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For prime p and a finite A in ZMod p, the restricted self-sumset of sums a + b with a != b has cardinality at least min(p, 2 * card A - 3), under an explicitly selected small-cardinality and subtraction convention.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies only a lower-bound gloss. It neither defines subset sum nor selects all-subset sums, restricted one-set pairs, the later restricted two-set theorem, or the h-fold Dias da Silva-Hamidoune theorem. The inspected secondary survey also says the conjecture did not occur in the catalog-associated 1964 paper. A source-approved primary statement, proof ownership boundary, domains, ordered binders, arithmetic carrier, and degenerate cases are required before selecting a proposition.
target_decision: preserve the Erdos-Heilbronn restricted-addition family while leaving the canonical proposition null until independently reviewed primary sources select one exact variant

canonical_formal_target.candidate_boundary: Finset.subsetSum is the all-subsets construction, while ZMod.cauchy_davenport concerns unrestricted A + B. Generic product/filter/image APIs could encode restricted pair sums but do not select or prove the source target. No obvious exact pinned declaration was located by the bounded intake search.
